title: SMS Registration Fees
description: Carrier fees for US A2P 10DLC registration, per carrier and subject type, in USD. Passed through to the customer at cost.

faster_lane_usd.description: business_low_volume only: the brand vetting Hail asks for when the carrier cannot verify a low-volume company that allowed the faster lane. Absent means the carrier has no faster lane.

last_verified.description: When these fees were last checked, when it differs from the provider's last_verified.

verification_method.description: How these fees were checked, when it differs from the provider's verification_method.

minimum_months.description: Monthly campaign fees the carrier bills at least, counted from approval, even when the registration is cancelled sooner. Absent means 1.

verification_method.description: How the fees were checked. "unverified" means copied from another source and not yet checked against the carrier.

business_low_volume.description: A company that chose low volume: a brand with no secondary vetting and a LOW_VOLUME campaign. Absent means the carrier has no low-volume filing: such a company files the vetted brand and pays the business prices.
